caption:
Here's what happened in AI in the last 24 hours, from Claude finding a CRISPR-like enzyme in DNA to GPT-6 dropping its price in half 👇

Claude found a new enzyme system hidden in bacteriophage DNA that looks exactly like CRISPR, the gene-editing tool that rewrote medicine, and scientists don't yet know what it does.

Grok Bot usage is growing faster than anything xAI has ever built.

Claude Opus 5.5 is live: 40% cheaper than Opus 5, 30% faster, and matching Fable 5.1 performance.

GPT-6 Sol and Luna are out: better at coding and alignment than the 5.6 family, and half the cost to use.

ChatGPT Voice now links to your email, calendar, and Slack, and you can build docs and spreadsheets just by talking, running on GPT-6.

Meta's new VR glasses weigh 100 grams, have micro-OLED displays, cost $1,299, and arrive Spring 2027.

One builder used Claude Opus 5.5 to make a 3-minute film about AI history, 7,400 lines of code, no stock footage, every frame drawn from scratch, done in about an hour.

Running a business? DM us "AI", we'll map out exactly what today's tools change for you.
